---
name: Never use --save_only_model for training
description: --save_only_model causes optimizer/scheduler state loss, making resume corrupt training (AdamW momentum resets)
type: feedback
---

Never use `--save_only_model` in training commands. It saves only model weights without optimizer/scheduler state. If training is later resumed from such a checkpoint, AdamW momentum resets to zero, causing training instability and PPL degradation (observed: 17.29 → 17.946 after resume).

**Why:** 2026-05-25 incident — q05/q03/q07 D&R experiments all had `--save_only_model`, and when killed+resumed, all produced degraded models due to missing optimizer state.

**How to apply:** Before submitting any training job, check the command does NOT contain `--save_only_model`. Use `--save_total_limit N` for disk management instead. If resume capability is needed, full checkpoint (with optimizer state) is mandatory.
